How to get it :
- Crafting table (x3) : Desh Powder, Euphemium Powder, [[gv:powder_power|Energy Powder]].
- [[SILEX|Laser Isotope Separation Chamber (SILEX)]] : [[gv:crystal_trixite|Trixite Crystals]].

Used to make :
[[gv:capacitor_spark|Spark Capacitor]], [[gv:battery_spark|Spark Battery]].
